Mathematics BSc/MSci at University College London

What University College London asks of applicants to Mathematics BSc/MSci for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University College London courses · Mathematics field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 0 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma (UCL’s A*A*A band, this course’s offer): 5,5 in two APs plus SAT 1500 or ACT 34, taken in the final three years of high school, with the High School Graduation Diploma
  • Alternatively 5,5,5,5,5 in five APs (taken in the final three years of high school), with no SAT/ACT

Chain: the 2027-entry course page (offer A*A*A) loads UCL’s international equivalency for its A-level band through its country selector; that data’s United States entry is shown here. Not re-checked automatically. Confirm this on the university’s page.

Subject prerequisites

  • Preferred third subject (official): Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Economics, English Language, English Literature, Physics or Statistics

Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement: accepted — see note
  • Advanced Placement (UCL’s A*A*A band): 5,5,5,5,5 in five APs, or 5,5 in two APs plus SAT 1500 or ACT 34 with the High School Graduation Diploma
  • Subject requirements carry over:
    • an A* or A subject needs a 5 in the relevant full-year AP (a B needs a 4)
    • where Mathematics or Physics is required, specific AP subjects are asked for
  • AP scores must be verified and sent to UCL by the College Board

UCL’s 2027 international equivalency for the A*A*A band, which the course page’s country selector loads for this course. UCL also says one year at a recognised US university or college (CGPA 3.3/4.0, around 30 semester credits) may be considered. Not re-checked automatically. Confirm this on the university’s page.

Other requirements
  • Resits are typically not accepted; one resit of Further Mathematics may be considered where grade A was first achieved early alongside GCSE or AS study
  • Deferred entry for the Year in Industry scheme is supported

The 2027 course page mentions no interview; STEP is part of an alternative offer route (see Admissions tests). Not re-checked automatically. Confirm this on the university’s page.
